ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a schematic map of an energy base in a certain province of China. Then reason: The question stem restricts the analysis of the leading factor in the location of China’s largest aluminum smelter to “from the perspective of raw material conditions.” The main raw material for aluminum smelting is bauxite; after identifying the province as Shanxi, combined with geographical knowledge, Shanxi has abundant bauxite reserves. Therefore, from the perspective of raw material conditions, what is mainly considered in the layout of the aluminum smelter is the abundance of local bauxite resources.
